correctness.rationale:
Sun’s exact (bn+1)/gcd(p^r,bn+1) divisibility ensures all n=p; because 0<=Q<=j−1

p/2 is necessary; count b in [ceil((p−j)p^r/j),p^r) in one class mod p minus one class mod p². Floor discrepancies <=2 per j give ≤2/p^{r−1} uniform error and the harmonic half-interval sum tends to log2; p=2 case empty. Independent Legendre valuations, whole-binomial small cases and progressions reproduced the claims.

value.rationale: Resolves the natural first-obstruction distribution for Sun’s established arithmetic function over a full prime-power parameter family with uniform exponent control, a nontrivial density 1−log2 rather than isolated small computations.

final_claim: For p prime,r>=2, p∤b and 1<=b<p^r, j the unique 1..p−1 solution bj≡−1(mod p), f(p^r,b)>j iff j+floor(bj/p^r)>=p and p²∤bj+1. Exact residue progression census has density tending uniformly (r>=2) to 1−log2 as p→∞.
limitations: Delayed-case exact later value of f is not claimed; b<p^r and r>=2 are essential.
